rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on overhang) with no third-party involvement or theft is straightforward property damage coverage.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch overhang: approximately four shingles blown off during last weekend's wind event. No interior water damage. Estimated repair cost $400. Low-severity claim ready for adjuster assessment.

case_facts.description: Wind blew approximately four shingles off the overhang above back porch
case_facts.interior_damage: None - no water intrusion into house
